original_test_intent: Read the VBIOS ROM version of every installed NVIDIA GPU through the approved NVFlash manufacturing query and verify each stable physical GPU against the exact expected firmware manifest without writing firmware.
original_method: Pin and verify architecture/OS-specific nvflash_mfg binary and query-only semantics; map UUID/serial/board/slot/BDF to expected version; capture nvidia-smi corroboration; run exact read-only query with no images/write flags; parse every target, reconcile count and expected version, inspect warnings/logs and prove no firmware or device state changed.
manual_activity: GPU firmware owner supplies and approves the vendor query-only NVFlash build and per-physical-GPU expected VBIOS manifest and owns mismatch disposition.
required_inputs: Signed nvflash_mfg binary/hash and vendor read-only command guide
Expected VBIOS version per physical GPU and manifest revision
Protected/redacted evidence path and no-write audit policy
safety_requirements: Inspect command/help and refuse any write/image/force/override option
Do not execute ambiguous target or unsupported binary
Map results by stable identity, never index alone
Stop on write prompt, missing/duplicate GPU, tool warning or version mismatch
Prove no flash process/state change and never respond to mismatch by flashing
agent_execution_scope: Run exact approved read-only query once
Cross-check all GPUs and compare versions
Report evidence without firmware action or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve binary/read semantics and expected manifest
Resolve any tool warning, missing GPU or version mismatch

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `nvflash --version` normally identifies the utility, not every GPU ROM, and the unsafe transport omits source nvflash_mfg query.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run vendor-approved local exact `./nvflash_mfg --v` query-only mode and capture complete per-GPU output; cross-check `nvidia-smi` using UUID and PCI bus ID.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Literal `--v`, all-GPU scope and five-minute timing remain; internal referenced script is an artifact to pin/review, not blindly execute.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Emit a per-physical-GPU table containing stable identity, NVFlash ROM value, nvidia-smi VBIOS value, expected manifest value and discrepancy status, plus a no-write process audit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes 'correct' explicit and prevents utility self-version from masquerading as ROM evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Driver-only VBIOS output is corroboration, not replacement for the source NVFlash query.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Multi-GPU enumeration order may differ between tools; identity mapping must not rely on index or line order.

project_override_considerations: Firmware owner defines allowed version differences across GPU board/SKU revisions and whether all slots must be homogeneous.
expected_evidence: NVFlash signature/hash/version, architecture support and query-only semantics
Stable GPU UUID/serial/board/slot/BDF inventory and expected manifest revision
Exact argv, complete raw per-GPU output, exit/timestamps and tool warnings
Process/argument/no-image/no-write audit and before/after GPU/log health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master coherently requires read-only VBIOS inventory; DeepSeek undercovers and mistypes the NVFlash output.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Approved binary, mapping and manifest are provisionable inputs; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Restores direct NVFlash ROM coverage, disambiguates utility and firmware versions, and adds stable identity plus write-capability containment.
independent_technical_reasoning: A firmware utility can expose both its own version and adapter ROM versions; using the wrong option yields plausible but irrelevant output. In multi-GPU systems, enumeration order can change, so each value must bind to stable identity before comparison. Because NVFlash is capable of writes even when the test is read-only, a no-image/no-write argument and process audit is required and version mismatch must never trigger an automatic flash.
